title: Implement capability lease model and policy evaluator
purpose: Represent permissions as short-lived semantic leases that can be audited and compiled into Linux execution constraints.
scope: Define capability levels: read-only, write-with-diff, execute-with-confirmation, privileged-with-human-approval, never.
Implement policy decisions: allow, deny, pause-for-approval.
Bind lease metadata to actor, tool, resource, parameter hash, expiration, and policy version.
Deny shell.exec, secret dump, raw block writes, and kernel module load in normal mode.
acceptance_criteria: Each semantic tool maps to exactly one risk class before execution.
High-risk tools pause unless a matching approval token exists.
Approval tokens cannot authorize changed parameters after issuance.
Denied tools are recorded without executing.
verification: Attempt parameter mutation after approval and confirm denial.
Inspect audit records for decision and lease fields.

completed_evidence.policy_demo: fs.write.diff pauses without approval, allows with exact approval, emits lease metadata, and denies shell.exec.

risk_notes: Approval must bind exact action parameters, not a broad session-level grant.
